integrity: Exact rational algebra, exhaustive small-size checks, explicit all-order zero-count and asymptotic arguments. Novelty is qualified by possible undiscovered historical specializations; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent placements on fixed finite connected trees; the covariance sign theorem is not asserted for weighted allocations or graphs with cycles. Real continuations index roots only and are not random sampling laws; finite tests do not prove all-order statements.
title: A universal one-crossing law for fragmentation under fixed-sample occupancy on trees
